## Activity

During May 2023, Hill Counties Health Centre completed 76 captures. This records the activity submitted by the site during the month and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. The capture total is reported without adjustment or exclusion.

## Image quality

Of the submitted captures, 4 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.3 per cent. This measure identifies images that could not be used for grading and should be considered alongside the overall capture activity when reviewing site performance. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

A total of 18 results were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. The results indicate that referable findings were identified within the month’s activity, while the median lag provides the central measure of the time taken for grading. Together, these figures summarise the grading workload and turnaround for May 2023.
